title: BUGFIX — telegram-bot PM2 max_memory_restart too low: bot restarts every ~30s
rationale: telegram-bot uses 234MB at steady state (ts-node + 10 large imported modules). max_memory_restart was 128M — PM2 OOM-kills and restarts it every ~30 seconds (65 restarts observed). Fix: raise ceiling to 512M, reload PM2, verify restarts stop.

tasks.description: In ecosystem.config.js, change max_memory_restart for telegram-bot from '128M' to '512M'. Then pm2 reload ecosystem.config.js --only telegram-bot to apply.
